name: prompt-queue
description: Queue prompts and slash commands with /queue while Claude works, then run them one by one after each task and its background jobs finish.

autoMode.title: Auto mode
autoMode.description: Initial auto state and whether /queue auto saves your choice. global-true/global-false write the choice back to settings for later sessions; session-true/session-false keep it in this session only.

aliases.title: Subcommand aliases
aliases.description: Comma-separated subcommand=alias pairs, for example auto=/queue-auto, list=ls. A leading / registers a top-level command; a bare word adds another /queue subcommand.
